Class RequestController

java.lang.Object
lt.viko.eif.imazolevska.jaxws_client.controller.RequestController
@RestController public class RequestController extends Object
Returns HTML and PDF reports to the browser. Gets the data from the SOAP service, converts it to XML and transforms it with the XSL stylesheets.
